extracted.intended_audience: Associated Press journalists, staff, contributors and freelancers (newsroom personnel)
extracted.subtask_short: AP newsroom ethics and news values
extracted.subtask_description: Organization-level standards and principles that govern how Associated Press journalists should gather, write, and present news to ensure accuracy, fairness, and independence; covers conflicts of interest, visuals, privacy, fabrication prevention, gifts, political activity, freelance work, and social media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report the news accurately and honestly
rubrics_metrics.description: It is our job — more than ever before — to report the news accurately and honestly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Telling the story: standards and practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Journalists at The Associated Press utilize a set of standards and practices that safeguards AP stories from bias and inaccuracies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: AP employees must avoid behavior or activities - political, social or financial - that create a conflict of interest or compromise our ability to report the news fairly and accurately, uninfluenced by any person or action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards (featured guideline)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as a core featured guideline for news values and principles (general standards for reporting).

rubrics_metrics.name: Visuals
rubrics_metrics.description: Visuals are a featured guideline area (standards governing use and presentation of images, video and other visual elements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Decency
rubrics_metrics.description: Decency is a featured guideline area (standards governing taste, sensitivity and respect for subjects and audiences).

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Privacy is a featured guideline area (standards governing treatment of private information and individuals' privacy interests).

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrity is a featured guideline area (standards ensuring honesty, independence and ethical behavior in reporting).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fabrications
rubrics_metrics.description: Fabrications is a featured guideline area (rules to prevent invention or falsification of facts or sources).

rubrics_metrics.name: Preventing favoritism
rubrics_metrics.description: Preventing favoritism is listed as a guideline (standards to avoid preferential treatment that could bias coverage).

rubrics_metrics.name: Gifts
rubrics_metrics.description: Gifts is a featured guideline area (rules governing acceptance of gifts that could create real or perceived influence).

rubrics_metrics.name: Preventing bias
rubrics_metrics.description: Preventing bias is listed among featured guidelines (standards and practices to ensure impartial, unbiased reporting).

rubrics_metrics.name: Political activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Political activities is a featured guideline area (rules limiting employees' political behavior that could compromise AP's neutrality).

rubrics_metrics.name: Other work
rubrics_metrics.description: Other work is a featured guideline area (standards governing outside employment or activities that might affect newsroom independence).

rubrics_metrics.name: Freelance work
rubrics_metrics.description: Freelance work is a featured guideline area (standards and expectations for freelancers contributing to AP).

rubrics_metrics.name: Social Media Guidelines (download)
rubrics_metrics.description: Social Media Guidelines are provided as a downloadable resource (rules and expectations for staff use of social media in relation to AP work).
